description: Java class 'RitaApi' providing an API client for interacting with a third-party service, including request/response field definitions, configuration, and communication logic.

classes.name: RitaApi
classes.description: A Java class for constructing, sending, and processing API requests/responses to a third-party service, with support for configuration and validation.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Sets a parameter value in the API request, converting the value to String.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a specified parameter from the API request.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the current request or response document.

methods.name: getDocument
methods.description: Returns the internal document map containing request/response fields.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends the API request over HTTP and processes the response, returning a new RitaApi instance with response data.
